about_the_game:
Get your hands dirty in the world of shady business!

"DarkFactory" is an online co-op management simulation game where you and your teammates run a not-so-legal factory together.

As one of the staff members of this dark factory, you’ll design production lines, manage risks, and cooperate to achieve the highest possible profit.

🏭 Game Overview

Work together with up to 4 players in real time to process incoming orders as efficiently as possible.

But be careful—your factory doesn’t just make legitimate products.
Producing defective (illegal) goods will skyrocket your efficiency and profits…
However, if the inspector catches you, the entire operation could be shut down in an instant!

⚙️ Key Features

  • Online Co-op (1–4 Players)
    Work together and divide roles strategically. Communication and teamwork are the keys to success.

  • Strategic Production Line Management
    Arrange machines, optimize workflows, and aim for maximum profit within a limited time.

  • Tense Encounters with Inspectors
    When an inspector shows up, it’s up to you how to handle it—
    distract them, bribe them, or just run for it!

  • Progression and Upgrades
    Each stage offers unique layouts and goals.
    Invest your earnings to purchase new machines and expand your factory.

  • Hilarious and Thrilling Co-op Experience
    Expect chaotic teamwork and laugh-out-loud moments:
    “Who’s paying the bribe?” “It’s fine, they won’t notice!”

🎯 Your Goal

Ship as many products as possible before time runs out and reach the target revenue.
But beware—taking too many risks can lead to a full factory shutdown!
Finding the balance between efficiency and morality is the key to success.

👥 Recommended For

  • Fans of management and factory simulation games

  • Players who enjoy chaotic online co-op experiences

  • Anyone who loves dark humor and lighthearted mischief

name: DarkFactory
short_description: Run a shady factory with your friends in this online co-op management game! Balance profits and risk by producing both legal and illegal goods— bribe inspectors, cover your tracks, and outsmart the system to stay in business!
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese
